title: Moroccan Chebakia Bites with Almond Crunch
description: A sweet and crunchy dessert inspired by Moroccan cuisine, perfect for snack or dessert. These bite-sized treats combine the crunch of almonds with the delicate taste of chebakia.

ingredients.name: Chebakia
ingredients.notes: available in most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: 2. Crush the almonds in a food processor until coarsely chopped.
3. In a large bowl, combine the chopped almonds, chebakia, and powdered sugar.
4. Add the melted Velveeta and mix until the mixture is well combined.
5. Add the honey syrup (oozy), melted butter, cardamom, and salt. Mix until the mixture is smooth and well combined.
6. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
7. Using a cookie scoop or spoon, drop the mixture into balls, about 1 inch (2.5 cm) in diameter.
8. Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
9. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
10. Remove from the oven and let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes.
11. Transfer the bites to a wire rack to cool completely.
